preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of people n in each test case must be between 2 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 200000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each sociability parameter a_i must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 200000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(k) + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'{i} {j}' for i, j in talks)
postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximum number of talks k followed by k lines of pairs of people who will talk.
The number of talks output must match the maximum number of talks k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j for i, j in talks)
postconditions.description: Each talk must involve two distinct people within the range of 1 to n.
